detailed_description: The JSON to Swift tool automates the generation of type-safe Swift structs from JSON payloads using advanced type inference algorithms. By analyzing JSON structure and value patterns, the tool accurately maps primitive types (String, Int, Double, Bool), array collections, and nested objects to corresponding Swift data models. It leverages Swift's Codable protocol architecture to create structs with proper type annotations, including optional handling (T?), array generics ([T]), and enum representations for fixed-value fields. Developers benefit from reduced manual coding errors when implementing API response models, local data persistence structures, or third-party SDK integrations. The tool's intelligent schema detection resolves ambiguous type cases through context-aware analysis, while preserving JSON key naming conventions through customizable coding keys. Output includes properly indented Swift syntax with configurable access modifiers (public/internal/private) and optional documentation comment stubs, ensuring seamless integration into Xcode projects targeting iOS, macOS, or server-side Swift environments.
usage_steps: Paste raw JSON data into the syntax-highlighted input editor
Adjust the 'Struct Prefix' field to add custom命名空间 identifiers
Select desired access control level from the 'Visibility' dropdown menu
Toggle 'Include Documentation Comments' for empty comment templates
Click the 'Generate Swift Struct' button to execute conversion
Copy the formatted Swift code from the output panel using the clipboard icon
usage_examples: Creating type-safe models for REST API responses in an iOS weather application
Generating data transfer objects (DTOs) for Firebase Firestore document mapping
Converting complex nested JSON from a GraphQL API into queryable Swift structs
Building configuration models from dynamic JSON settings files in macOS apps
